1263-1531-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1263-1531-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Deathgreeter and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill 5 cards.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-3899-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2366-3899-4875-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Conspiracy.
2366-3899-4875-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1012-4247-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-4247-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

5641-5805-6566.easyPrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5641-5805-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

277-851-1308-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-851-1308-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

4390-5078-6757-7633-7753.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6757-7633-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Valeria Richards.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

1879-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1367-7068-7417.description:
If Nexus of Fate is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Nexus of Fate and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Sanar. At the beginning of your end step, Sanar is returned to the battlefield. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1367-7068-7417.notes: If Nexus of Fate is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

65-2546-2628-2993--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {0} due to Fluctuator and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Surly Badgersaur trigger.
Resolve Surly Badgersaur's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding (1).
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Stoic Builder.
When Stoic Builder enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
65-2546-2628-2993--38.notes: Since you can draw your entire library, discarding down to maximum hand size at end of turn will trigger Surly Badgersaur's abilities many times.

339-413-677-6968.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2086-6798-6824.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1003-5220-5683-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Phyrexian Walker and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

914-3036-3499.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-3499.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1497-4893-5217-6006.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-2397-4124-5954-6664.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

997-1349-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
997-1349-6012.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

261-2452-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1575-2981-4231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-2981-4231.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1971-4499-4929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater, or have one exiled by Yannik.
1971-4499-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Yannik.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, all creatures exiled with it return to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling another creature you control with power two or greater and putting at least two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2232-4399-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
You have a white nonartifact permanent card in hand with mana cost {W}.
You control a nontoken nonartifact white permanent with mana cost {W} that shares a card type with the card in hand.
2232-4399-4740.description:
Cast the white permanent card in your hand by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Faith and Aetherflux Reservoir triggers.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
The white permanent enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning another nontoken nonartifact white permanent with mana cost {W} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinite times to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1271-3212-3617.description:
Tap Scroll Rack and pay {1} to activate it, putting Time Walk on top of your library.
Pass the turn.
On your next draw step, when you draw Time Walk, reveal it due to Kefnet's ability, making a copy that costs {2} less to cast.
Cast the copy for {U}, granting you an extra turn.

3375-3518-4694-5105.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}; it enters the battlefield as a 1/1 artifact creature.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Sigil of the New Dawn triggers, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Lion's Eye Diamond from the graveyard to your hand.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite white mana, you may repeat the loop adding any color of mana in step 2.
